description:
Job Title: Power Platform Developer 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
 
Type of Travel: Local 
 
* * * 
 
 
 The Opportunity: 
We are seeking an in-person (5 days a week) Power Platform Developer with experience in end-to-end architecture and development utilizing Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI. This role will provide hands‑on development across our enterprise modernization and data initiatives to ensure scalable, secure, and robust implementations that support mission-critical programs and operations. This role is pivotal in designing, developing, and deploying custom solutions that streamline operations, enhance data visibility, and support smarter decision-making across the company.  Working on the Operational Excellence team, the role requires being able to manage competing development priorities and maintain code quality across all work.
 
This position is full-time, in person in a CACI office. Preferably in the Norfolk, VA or Reston VA headquarters office. 


 Responsibilities: 
·       Application Development : Independently design, architect, test, and fully build custom managed solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform suite of tools, within an environment without premium licenses ,including PowerFX, Canvas apps with SharePoint lists, and standard connectors. Ensure applications are intuitive, scalable, maintainable, responsive, and meet stakeholder needs. Integrate securely with enterprise data sources. Utilize CSS and HTML to improve layout, content presentation and enhance user interfaces.  


 Workflows and Automation : Design, test, and maintain sophisticated Power Automate workflows for stand-alone solutions or in conjunction with Power App solutions to automate business critical processes. Experience working in a limited environment without premium connector access to develop solutions, loops and complex workflow logic, and failure/error handling.  Ability to work with JSON data when building flows and connecting to APIs, including basic parsing, formatting, and troubleshooting payload issues.
 Data Visualization:  Develop and maintain dynamic dashboards and reports using Power BI to support data-driven insights. Utilize advanced report design, DAX, and Power Query to create meaningful visualizations.  Ensure all visualizations include role-based permissions to avoid data spillage.
 Solution Architecture:  Work closely with stakeholders and teammates to own the solution development process. This includes eliciting and documenting requirements, designing data architecture and flows, developing, testing, and delivering individual solutions, while keeping the larger enterprise architecture in mind. This includes creating SharePoint sites, lists, and role-based permissions as part of the solution. Ensure full solutions are user-friendly and align with business goals.
 Process Analysis:  Analyze business processes, utilize generative AI, and develop: tools, reports, or other solutions to meet business needs. Translate complex business requirements into solutions. Serve as technical advisor to stakeholders; translate high‑complexity business needs into multi‑component architectures and implementation roadmaps.
 Governance, Standards & Best Practices:  Adhere to team standards and governance principles, including styles, documentation, and configuration management. Provide enhancement ideas to the team’s Power Platform governance models and other team operations. Ensure all development is well-documented and follows best practices. Collaborate with other developers on architecture, coding practices, automation logic, and solution design.
 Operational Support:  Provide operational support for deployed solutions, addressing any issues or enhancements required post-deployment. Analyze issues, perform root cause analysis and recommend remediation for long-term platform and solution health.  Document all relevant findings for later review to facilitate continuous improvement.
 Training and Documentation:  Maintain comprehensive documentation. Support training efforts to facilitate user adoption across teams and to ensure users are well-versed in utilizing new solutions.
 Continuous Learning:  Stay current on Microsoft Power Platform, SharePoint, AI tools, and industry best practices. Be willing to learn new technologies and incorporate them into solutions as needed.


 Qualifications: 

 Required:  
 Must be a U.S. Citizen 
 3-5 years proven experience with designing, architecting, and developing enterprise solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, PowerFX, and SharePoint) and Microsoft 365 ecosystem
 Strong knowledge and experience utilizing standard data modeling techniques and system architecture to design and wireframe solutions 
 Experience with data analysis, DAX optimization, Power Query, and advanced PowerBI modeling, design and development
 UI/UX Graphic design experience for custom applications
 Experience with connecting to varied data sources
 Proven ability to quickly translate business needs into scalable, user-friendly solutions
 Excellent communication, documentation, problem-solving, analysis, collaboration, and stakeholder-facing skills
 Experience conducting user acceptance testing and remediations 

 Desired: 

 Experience with custom API Connections utilizing REST APIs
 Experience with App Health Checker and writing delegable queries/formulas
 Demonstrated experience modernizing legacy processes or systems into scalable enterprise solutions
 Experience with writing and managing user acceptance tests
 Experience with Power BI tiles in Canvas apps or SharePoint sites
 Experience with Microsoft Power Platform governance and Center of Excellence practices
 Microsoft certification(s) in Power Platform (e.g., PL-100, PL-200, PL-300, PL-400, PL-900)
 Experience working in Federal or Government Contracting industry or regulated environment
 
 
 
 
This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI. 
 

 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$82,100-$172,400 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
